public_rationale: The OpenScholar findings date to 2024 and were published in Nature in 2026: experts preferred OpenScholar-GPT-4o responses over expert-written responses in 70% of comparisons on its scientific literature benchmark [e3]. The June 9, 2026 SciConBench preprint reports that the best tested agent achieved factual F1 of 0.337 under clean-room conditions [e4]. These results show a favorable synthesis comparison and continuing synthesis limitations, but do not establish independently replicated superiority over competent humans in both reasoning reliability and synthesis across diverse tasks [e3][e4]. Neither establishes that eventual attainment is impossible, leaving the forecast unresolved [e3][e4].
limitations: Expert preference on the OpenScholar benchmark does not establish broad reasoning superiority or independently replicated synthesis superiority [e3].
SciConBench evaluates scientific synthesis by tested systems; it does not establish the limits of future systems [e4].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: We will build machines that reason more reliably than humans do, which is already the case but only in limited circumstances, and that synthesize information far better than humans can.
conditions: already the case, but only in limited circumstances

statement.excerpt: We will build machines that reason more reliably than we do (already the case, but only in limited circumstances), and synthesize information far better than we can.
statement.document_title: AI versus The Clumsy Human Mind

from_speaker: reason more reliably than we do
already the case, but only in limited circumstances
synthesize information far better than we can
our_interpretation: The plain reading is broad superiority in both reasoning reliability and information synthesis, extending beyond the limited circumstances he explicitly concedes.
The comparison is with competent humans performing matched tasks, including relevant experts for specialist work.
Far better means a substantial, reproducible advantage in quality, not merely faster production.
The parenthetical statement is a concession about existing capabilities, not a condition that must occur before the forecast applies.
criteria.support_condition: Independent comparisons establish that built machines reason more reliably and produce substantially better information synthesis than competent humans across diverse tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive result rules out the eventual combined capability. Present benchmark failures do not contradict an undated forecast.
